userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: Vehicle/right shows no check-out for a completed stay (APDS Use Case C.2.2 transaction exception).
Vehicle occupies a different space than reserved/checked-in (C.2.2 transaction exception).
Space occupied with no matching check-in/session (C.2.2 space status).
Non-EV vehicle occupying an EV charging space (C.2.2 transaction exception).
Session exceeds its right's validity or maximum stay.
A device reports a fault state.
A device stopped communicating (lastCommunication exceeded threshold).
A lane is blocked (vehicle stuck, barrier obstruction).
Occupancy demand crossed a configured threshold for a place element.
A payment failed, was reversed, or requires attention.
A customer requested assistance at a lane/device intercom.
A subscription exhausted its delivery retry schedule and was marked failed (self-referential alert).

An operator-defined alert that a vehicle travelled against a lane's configured purpose (e.g. entered on an exit lane). APX does not raise it or define when it applies: LPR reads carry only the vehicle's accessEvent, and the lane used does not change it (Part 13 §13.3a(6)).

A vehicle has occupied an EV charging bay without connecting beyond the place's grace — the EV counterpart of iceInEvSpace, derived from the Part 23 §23.3 bay-presence fusion; the camera Observation is the evidence.

An EV charging bay is obstructed by something other than a parked vehicle (cones, debris, a straddling vehicle), derived from the Part 23 §23.3 bay-presence fusion; the camera Observation is the evidence.
A credential on a watch plate list (Part 24) was read at a place where the list has alertOnArrival; relatedEntity is the PlateListEntry, the read is the evidence.
A credential on a scofflaw plate list (Part 24) was read at a place where the list has alertOnArrival; relatedEntity is the PlateListEntry.

A credential on a plate list with refuseService arrived at a lane and service was refused (the refused-service sign shown, the gate not vended); relatedEntity is the PlateListEntry, the displayMessage command's result.display is the proof of display.
